text: Number of employees per department changing over time

metadata.query: WITH RECURSIVE bounds AS (SELECT YEAR(MIN(from_date)) AS first_year, GREATEST(MAX(from_date), COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN to_date < '9999-01-01' THEN to_date END), MAX(from_date))) AS last_date FROM dept_emp), years AS (SELECT first_year AS yr FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT yr + 1 FROM years CROSS JOIN bounds WHERE yr < YEAR(last_date)), events AS (SELECT dept_no, YEAR(from_date) AS yr, 1 AS delta FROM dept_emp UNION ALL SELECT dept_no, YEAR(to_date) AS yr, -1 AS delta FROM dept_emp WHERE to_date < '9999-01-01'), annual AS (SELECT dept_no, yr, SUM(delta) AS delta FROM events GROUP BY dept_no, yr) SELECT LEAST(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(y.yr, '-12-31'), '%Y-%m-%d'), b.last_date) AS snapshot_date, d.dept_name, SUM(COALESCE(a.delta,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.dept_no ORDER BY y.yr) AS employee_count FROM years y CROSS JOIN departments d CROSS JOIN bounds b LEFT JOIN annual a ON a.dept_no = d.dept_no AND a.yr = y.yr ORDER BY snapshot_date, d.dept_name;
metadata.dashboard_description: The dashboard provides insights into the annual employee count trends by department, highlighting changes over time and allowing for analysis of workforce dynamics within the organization.
